title: BLAI Short Storyboard v3
description: The ONLY handoff between storyboard and downstream stages. Scene narrations joined with single spaces MUST equal narration_full exactly. Style packs, layout archetypes, sfx markers. How the story is told is the writer's call — no structural template is encoded here.

title.description: ≤40 chars ideal (mobile truncation); keyword first; question-phrasing when natural; never verbatim hook_text

description.description: Restated keyword-rich title line, a 2-3 sentence setup, a 'You'll learn…' line, then the CTA + '(Narration is AI-generated.)'

hashtags.description: 8–12 targeted tags. Lead with the specific product/model name — channel search traffic is dominated by product queries.

tags.description: OPTIONAL YouTube keyword tags (the Studio 'Tags' box, not hashtags). 15–25 lowercase phrases; include product names, the question form, and adjacent search terms.

hook_candidates.description: The ≥10 hooks written before picking (Hoyos practice); shown at Gate 1

style_pack.description: Check docs/styles/history.json — never the same pack as the previous video

script_format.description: Optional; absent = classic. Per-format bands (duration, words, numbers policy, person) live in pipeline/formats.json — the validator enforces them.

structure.description: Optional; the narrative shape chosen from script-structures.md (worked-example, myth-bust, comparison-ladder, news-react-so-what, how-to-three-moves, contrarian-take, story-first, number-first). Free text: the validator never rejects a value; the list in skills/script-gates/formats.json is informational and independent of script_format.

value_types.description: Optional; the two locked value types from brand-vault/value-framework.md, comma-separated (TEACHES, EQUIPS, REFRAMES, PROVES). Carried for the audit, not validated.

target_duration_s.description: Union bound; the REAL band is per-format in pipeline/formats.json (classic 28–60 target 32–38; smooth-explainer 60–180 target 75–150)

narration_full.description: Union bound; per-format words band in pipeline/formats.json (classic ~85–110 words; smooth-explainer 250–450). Numbers as SPOKEN words. FK grade ≤5.

analogy.description: OPTIONAL creative note — if the script leans on one central analogy, record it for the reviewer. Never required, never validated.

vehicle.description: The central analogy, if the script uses one

mapping.description: How it maps back to the real thing

limit.description: Where the analogy breaks, if that matters here

role.description: hook must be first (promise + frame-1 legible text); payoff_close must be last (delivers the promise, abrupt end, wordmark settle). Middle scenes are free — 'explain' and 'foreshadow' are interchangeable labels, foreshadow retained for back-compat with shipped boards.

visual_brief.description: Concrete and buildable; must specify a visual change at least every ~3s of the scene; hook scene must specify the frame-1 composition AND the ≤0.5s motion onset

render_notes.description: Optional producer hints for the scene worker (props, motifs, references) — passed verbatim, not validated for style

sfx.description: ≤6 total per video; boundaries + number reveals only
